description: Vozni redovi - autobusne linije is a dataset listed in Open Data Portal Croatia, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Općina Hum na Sutli. timetables - bus lines from Hum to Sutla. Coverage: Općina Hum na Sutli. The portal shows the English title as "Timetables - bus lines" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Općina Hum na Sutli. Its keywords include autobusne linije. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://data.gov.hr/otvorena-dozvola). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-portal-otvorenih-podataka.
